themes.description: Users consistently report that the app's customer service relies solely on an unhelpful chatbot or provides no response, leaving technical and financial issues unresolved.
themes.business_impact: Customers are abandoning trades, filing regulatory complaints, and generating negative reviews, which erodes brand trust and increases churn risk directly affecting revenue streams.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support system lacks a robust ticketing workflow and human escalation path, relies on a limited chatbot, and has insufficient staffing/knowledge base to handle complex financial queries.
themes.action_plan:
• Implement a ticketing system with SLA tracking
• Add trained human agents for critical issues
• Integrate multi‑channel support (email, live chat, phone)
• Develop a comprehensive knowledge base and FAQ
• Monitor response metrics and iterate based on feedback

themes.description: Users report excessive transaction fees, high margin on MTF rates, and unfavorable forex exchange rates, causing dissatisfaction and perceived exploitation.
themes.business_impact: Directly erodes user profit margins on trades and transfers, leading to decreased user trust, lower trading volume, and increased churn risk among cost-sensitive traders.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The platform’s fee structure is aggressive and lacks transparent disclosure, driven by a high-markup strategy on MTF rates and forex conversion, possibly to compensate for operational costs or to maximize revenue from a limited fee base.
themes.action_plan: • 1) Conduct a comprehensive audit of all fee components and compare against industry benchmarks. 2) Reduce MTF rate markup and introduce tiered pricing based on trade volume. 3) Remove or lower forex conversion markups and clearly display real-time rates with transparent GST breakdown. 4) Update the UI to prominently show fee and rate details before trade confirmation. 5) Communicate changes via in-app notifications and email to restore confidence.
